evidence: Fig. 2 shows 500 nm × 500 nm AFM images of Ga 2O3 films grown at 120 °C, 250 °C and 400 °C, selected to represent each crystal phase observed, and a summary plot of the root mean squared (RMS) roughness for this sample set. At 150 °C and below, the topography of the samples seems to indicate that the surface is amorphous and the RMS roughness values below 0.5 nm indicate a very uniform, conformal deposition. Between 200 °C and 350 °C, corresponding to the α phase, the films show a slight increase in roughness (between 0.5 nm and 0.7 nm) and the presence of grain-like structure with lateral size of around 10 nm (accurate measurement is impeded by the radius of the AFM tip).
